images.author: Nicholas A. Tonelli from Pennsylvania, USA
images.caption: Farmstead, Washington Township, Erie County.

brief: Concrete stave silo about 14 ft across and 45 ft high whose staves were painted in alternating white and brick-red checks, now chalky and rust-streaked so the pattern reads as a patchy red-and-white checkerboard, bound with steel hoops. Topped by a bright galvanized steel dome roof with a small hatch; a white vertical pipe climbs the front and a small white block silo room stands at its foot. It rises against the gable of a weathered grey plank barn with a green roof.

facade.notes: the 'Checkered Silo' (Washington Twp PA, c.1930): a concrete stave silo painted in white and red checks, now rust-streaked, with a galvanized dome; beside a cluster of weathered grey board barns and sheds with green metal roofs, a newer metal pole barn, a pasture in front

why.note: the dairy farm's silo: concrete staves from c.1910, built against the barn's end so silage could be pitched down a chute into the feeding alley
the farmstead: barns, sheds and silos clustered by the lane, added one at a time as the farm grew
